newsitem.title: FRANCE: French July M3 money supply fell 0.2 percent.
newsitem.headline: French July M3 money supply fell 0.2 percent.

text.p: French M3 money supply fell 0.2 percent in July after falling a revised 0.8 percent in June, the Bank of France said on Friday.
The Bank said M3 grew 0.8 percent year on year. The year-on-year change is expressed as a three-month average centred on the previous month.
The Bank originally said M3 shrank 0.7 percent in June.
The Bank of France gave the following money supply figures (the year-on-year change is expressed as an average centred on the previous month)
Money measure Billions Monthly change 12-month change
The central bank is targeting M3 growth of roughly five percent a year on average over the next few years.
It is using total domestic debt as a secondary monitoring tool.
